card.name: Periodically in monitoring schedules
card.fires_on: The word "periodically" (or "periodic") after a monitoring schedule such as "and" or "then", and quantity words like "variety", "millions" or "thousands" after "and" or "a" in general text.

modes.label: Periodic monitoring
modes.description: "Periodically" or "periodic" ends a schedule of lab tests, often just before "thereafter".
modes.example: Measure hemoglobin prior to initiation of ambrisentan tablets, at one month, and<< periodically>> thereafter.

modes.label: Vague large amounts
modes.description: Quantity words such as variety, millions or thousands that introduce an unspecified large number.
modes.example: Michigan has over 11,000 smaller lakes and<< thousands>> of miles of rivers and streams.

card.writes: It favors words like "thereafter" and suppresses words meaning "many" or "numerous", so it expects a follow-up phrase rather than a count.
card.plain: It marks the word "periodically" in lab-monitoring schedules, and also words like "thousands" or "a variety" that stand for a vague number.
